req.title: Include Content-Length on echo responses
req.statement: The system shall include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length on echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length. Tests cover: (1) positive EP cases for each method verifying Content-Length presence and exact value match, (2) negative/NEG cases verifying the header is not absent or wrong, (3) BVA cases for empty body vs non-empty body requests, and (4) DT cases covering multiple endpoints with different payloads. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact integer equality between Content-Length header value and len(response.data), catching off-by-one mutations, missing-header mutations, and wrong-value mutations.

tests.name: test_get_content_length_exact_match
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_content_length_exact_match():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    body_len = len(r.data)
    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl > 0

test_get_content_length_exact_match()

tests.name: test_content_length_with_query_params_get
actions: Send GET request to /get with query parameters
Compare Content-Length with and without params
expected: Content-Length reflects larger body when query params are present
Content-Length == len(response.data) exactly in both cases
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_with_query_params_get():
    r_plain = client.get('/get')
    assert r_plain.status_code == 200
    cl_plain = int(r_plain.headers['Content-Length'])
    assert cl_plain == len(r_plain.data)

    r_params = client.get('/get?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r_params.status_code == 200
    cl_params = int(r_params.headers['Content-Length'])
    assert cl_params == len(r_params.data)
    assert cl_params > cl_plain

test_content_length_with_query_params_get()

tests.name: test_content_length_header_is_integer_string
actions: Attempt to parse Content-Length as integer
Verify it is not empty string, not negative, not non-numeric
expected: Content-Length is a valid non-negative integer string
Parsing as int does not raise ValueError
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_header_is_integer_string():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl_str = r.headers['Content-Length']
    assert cl_str != ''
    cl = int(cl_str)
    assert cl >= 0
    assert cl == len(r.data)
    assert cl_str == str(len(r.data))

test_content_length_header_is_integer_string()

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_have_content_length
preconditions: All five echo endpoints are available
actions: Send appropriate request to each of /get /post /put /patch /delete
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_have_content_length():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get', None, None),
        ('POST', '/post', b'{}', 'application/json'),
        ('PUT', '/put', b'{}', 'application/json'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch', b'{}', 'application/json'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete', None, None),
    ]
    for method, path, data, ct in cases:
        kwargs = {}
        if data:
            kwargs['data'] = data
        if ct:
            kwargs['content_type'] = ct
        r = client.open(path, method=method, **kwargs)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} got {r.status_code}"
        assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers, f"{method} {path} missing Content-Length"
        cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
        assert cl == len(r.data), f"{method} {path}: CL={cl} body={len(r.data)}"

test_all_echo_endpoints_have_content_length()

tests.name: test_content_length_changes_with_larger_payload
preconditions: POST /post endpoint reflects posted data in response
actions: Send POST with small JSON body
Send POST with larger JSON body
Verify Content-Length grows proportionally and matches body each time
expected: Content-Length for larger payload > Content-Length for smaller payload
Both Content-Length values equal their respective body lengths exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_changes_with_larger_payload():
    small = json.dumps({"a": "1"})
    r_small = client.post('/post', data=small, content_type='application/json')
    assert r_small.status_code == 200
    cl_small = int(r_small.headers['Content-Length'])
    assert cl_small == len(r_small.data)

    large = json.dumps({"a": "1" * 500})
    r_large = client.post('/post', data=large, content_type='application/json')
    assert r_large.status_code == 200
    cl_large = int(r_large.headers['Content-Length'])
    assert cl_large == len(r_large.data)
    assert cl_large > cl_small

test_content_length_changes_with_larger_payload()

tests.name: test_content_length_matches_utf8_encoded_body
actions: Send POST with unicode JSON body
Verify Content-Length equals byte length (not char length) of response body
expected: Content-Length is not equal to character count if they differ
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_matches_utf8_encoded_body():
    payload = json.dumps({"msg": "hello"})
    r = client.post('/post', data=payload, content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    body_bytes = r.data
    assert isinstance(body_bytes, bytes)
    assert cl == len(body_bytes)
    assert cl == len(r.data)

test_content_length_matches_utf8_encoded_body()
